descriptionChirho: Gentilic proper noun referring to the Ammonite people or an individual Ammonite, appearing in various grammatical forms: singular, plural, feminine plural, with article, with conjunctions, and with prepositions. All senses denote the same ethnic/national identity. Spanish uniformly uses 'amonita/amonitas,' Hindi 'ammoni/ammoniyon,' Arabic 'al-ammuni/ammuniyyat,' Korean 'ammon saram/ammon indeul,' Swahili 'Mwamoni/Waamoni.' The variation is purely morphological (number, gender, definiteness, prepositional attachment), not semantic.
